name: Plummet
overview: The Bible uses the plummet, or plumbline, as a powerful symbol of God's righteous judgment and standard of truth. In Amos, the Lord stands with a plumbline to measure His people Israel, signifying His unwavering evaluation and the certainty of His judgment. Isaiah connects the plummet with righteousness and judgment that will sweep away falsehood, emphasizing God's commitment to justice. Zechariah highlights the plummet as a sign of God's watchful eyes and the encouragement found even in small beginnings, pointing to His sovereign oversight and the fulfillment of His purposes.
